blePermissionsRequired: Bluetooth and location permissions are required to scan and program locks.
bleOff: Bluetooth is turned off. Turn on Bluetooth and try again.
bleUnsupported: This device does not support Bluetooth needed for lock operations.
bleConnectTimeout: Could not connect over Bluetooth (or TTLock SDK was not initialized). Stay within 1 m, turn Bluetooth on, wake the lock, then retry. If it persists after updating the app: clear app cache or reinstall.
bleConnectTimeoutProvision: Bluetooth step failed while programming the lock (not the server). Stay within 1 m, wake the lock, tap Initialize again. If the lock is already on TTLock cloud, cancel and use Link existing on the room/unit.
lockNotInSettingMode: This lock is already initialized. Use Link existing on the room/unit, or reset the lock hardware to enter setup mode.
apiBaseHint: Use your PC LAN IP on a real phone (not 10.0.2.2). Example: http://192.168.1.104:8000
apiBaseDevHostOnDevice: 10.0.2.2 and localhost only work on the emulator. On a real phone use your PC’s LAN IP, e.g. http://192.168.1.104:8000
networkUnreachable: Cannot reach the server at {{url}}. Use the same Wi‑Fi as your PC, check Herd is running, and use http://YOUR-PC-IP:8000 (central API, not a tenant subdomain).
ttlockSslError: The server could not connect to TTLock (SSL/certificate). On the Laravel server set TTLOCK_HTTP_VERIFY=false for local dev or install a CA bundle (CURL_CA_BUNDLE).
emptyTenants: No tenants available for your account.
emptySiteHint: Add buildings, gates, elevators, or parking in the tenant admin.
emptySiteSearch: No site units match your search.
emptyProperty: No rooms on this tenant yet.
emptyPropertySearch: No units match your search or filter.
emptyUnlinkedHint: Program a new lock or sync from TTLock cloud from the header.
emptyUnlinkedSearch: No unlinked locks match your search.
unlinkedSearchPlaceholder: Search name, alias, MAC, or lock ID…
linkSuccess: Lock linked successfully. When TTLock cloud is enabled, the server also registers the lock on cloud for remote passcodes.
lockPayloadConfirmHint: Review all fields (including lock_id and lock_data) before sending.
apiTenantForbidden: You cannot access this tenant. Choose another property or sign in again.
apiPropertyAlreadyHasLock: This unit already has a lock. Open lock details and unlink it before linking another.
apiPropertyNotFound: Room or unit was not found on the server.
apiLockNotFound: Lock was not found. Pull to refresh unlinked locks or sync TTLock from the server.
apiRequestTimeout: The server took too long to respond. Check Wi‑Fi and try again.
apiInvalidResponse: Unexpected response from the server. Check the server URL and that lock-setup API is running.
apiNoTenantSelected: No tenant selected. Go back and choose a property.
provisionLockMissingAfterSync: Lock was registered on TTLock but not found after sync. Sync again from Unlinked tab, then use Link existing.
ttlockCloudListFailed: Could not load locks from TTLock cloud on the phone. Check internet and TTLock credentials on the server.
unlockNoLockLinked: No lock is linked to this unit.
unlockConfirmHint: Review the plaintext below. Copy if needed, then tap Unlock to open the door.
unlockDiagHintNoWireKey: Wire key missing in app. Add EXPO_PUBLIC_LOCK_DATA_WIRE_KEY to .env.local, run npx expo start -c, or install a new APK with EAS.
unlockDiagHintStillEncrypted: Data still encrypted (ldw1/lds1). Check wire key OK, lock db id, and app 1.0.8+.
unlockDiagHintBadLength: Unexpected lockData length. Pull to refresh bootstrap or re-link the lock.
unlockDiagHintTtlockReject: TTLock rejected lockData (e.g. parameter error). Old app build or stale lockData — re-provision or install 1.0.12+.
unlockDiagHintTtlockRejectFresh: Crypto OK. If still parameter error after 1.0.13+: factory-reset the lock, init in setting mode, register again. Stay within 1m.
unlockDiagHintShaMismatch: SHA-256 mismatch: decrypted lockData differs from the server blob — update the app (1.0.12+), pull to refresh, or check wire key.
unlockDiagHintNoDbId: Missing lock database id — reopen room details after refresh.
unlockDiagHintGeneric: Check Settings (app version + wire key OK) and retry near the lock.
roomPasscodesEmpty: No passcodes yet for this room.
passcodeCreated: Passcode created and saved (via cloud, no Bluetooth)
passcodeCreatedHint: Hidden by default. Reveal to view, or copy without showing it.
passcodeApiMissing: This API server does not have the passcode endpoints yet. Point EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE at a backend that includes lock passcodes, or deploy the latest CheckinAccess API.
passcodeLockNotOnCloud: This lock cannot generate a remote cloud passcode. Stay near the lock so the app can write the code over Bluetooth, or finish registering it on TTLock cloud first.
passcodeNeedsNearLockOnce: Remote passcodes are not enabled for this lock yet. Stand within 1 m of the lock once — the app will sync password data, then you can generate codes remotely without Bluetooth.
passcodeNearLockHint: Prefers TTLock cloud (no Bluetooth). Newly programmed locks are auto-registered on cloud when possible; older local-only locks may still need Bluetooth nearby.
passcodeSchedulePermanentHint: Permanent code: valid from now with no end date.
passcodeScheduleCombinedHint: Pick from date+time to date+time. Generated via API / TTLock cloud — no Bluetooth.
passcodeScheduleStartFuture: Start must be in the future.
passcodeAssigneeHint: Optional — who this passcode is for.
passcodeAssigneeSearch: Search by name, mobile, or email
roomHasLockMessage: Unlink the current lock from the lock details page before adding or linking another.
unitHasLockTitle: This unit already has a lock
unitHasLockMessage: Unlink the current lock from the lock details page before adding or linking another.
